confidence_notes: I ran one RBA search and one Jeonju price search. The search results gave the RBA rate as 0.6720 for 2026-11-18. Restaurant meals, coffee and beer come from crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators that disagree with each other, so treat them as rough. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price, using a typical Korean bar markup. I did not search for accommodation. Those four anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Jeonju, which is a domestic tourism city with a hanok village and cheap guesthouses.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jeonju is a mid-sized Korean city with prices below Seoul and Busan. Its hanok-stay tourism pushes mid-range accommodation prices up slightly.
